findings.description: The overflow short-circuit now computes math.log(self.multiplier, self.exp_base) separately. This raises ValueError when multiplier <= 0, and the old combined form could do the same, but the new form also behaves differently for some multiplier values.
findings.rationale: Trigger: wait_exponential(multiplier=0) with finite max and exp_base>1. math.log(0, base) raises ValueError (math domain error) inside the condition, which sits outside the try block that follows. The original max/multiplier would raise ZeroDivisionError for the same input. Impact: an exception on a path that is perhaps meant to be guarded, with only the exception type changed.
